class ImportedDatasetCatalog:
    """Read bounded record summaries from a validated ingestion registry."""

    def __init__(self, registry_root: Path, client: TimeNetClient | None = None):
        self.client = client or TimeNet(registry=registry_root)

    def list_records(
        self,
        dataset_id: str,
        dataset_version: str,
        *,
        page: int,
        page_size: int,
    ) -> ImportedRecordPage:
        dataset = self.load_dataset(dataset_id, dataset_version)
        records = dataset.records
        total_items = len(records)
        total_pages = math.ceil(total_items / page_size) if total_items else 0
        if total_pages and page > total_pages:
            raise ImportedDatasetUnavailable("Imported dataset page is out of range")
        start = (page - 1) * page_size
        summaries = [self._summary(record) for record in records[start : start + page_size]]
        return ImportedRecordPage(
            dataset_id=dataset_id,
            dataset_version=dataset_version,
            data=summaries,
            pagination=ImportedRecordPagination(
                page=page,
                page_size=page_size,
                total_items=total_items,
                total_pages=total_pages,
            ),
        )

    def load_dataset(self, dataset_id: str, dataset_version: str):
        if not re.fullmatch(r"[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9._/-]{0,127}", dataset_id):
            raise ImportedDatasetUnavailable("Imported dataset identity is invalid")
        try:
            return self.client.load(
                dataset_id, version=dataset_version, auto_build=False
            )
        except Exception as exc:
            raise ImportedDatasetUnavailable(
                "Validated imported dataset is unavailable from the local registry"
            ) from exc

    def get_record(self, dataset_id: str, dataset_version: str, record_key: str):
        if not re.fullmatch(r"[a-f0-9]{24}", record_key):
            raise ImportedDatasetUnavailable("Imported record identity is invalid")
        matches = [
            record
            for record in self.load_dataset(dataset_id, dataset_version).records
            if imported_record_key(record.record_id) == record_key
        ]
        if len(matches) != 1:
            raise ImportedDatasetUnavailable("Imported record was not found")
        return matches[0]

    @staticmethod
    def _summary(record) -> ImportedRecordSummary:
        series = list(record.time_series)
        torque = [
            item
            for item in series
            if item.spec.spec_type == "measured_external_joint_torque"
        ]
        expected_signals = {f"joint_{index}" for index in range(1, 8)}
        replay_compatible = (
            len(torque) == 7
            and {str(item.signal) for item in torque} == expected_signals
            and len({item.n_values for item in torque}) == 1
            and all(
                item.n_values > 1
                and getattr(item.time_axis, "period_us", None) == 1_000
                for item in torque
            )
        )
        durations = [
            (item.n_values - 1) * item.time_axis.period_us / 1_000_000
            for item in series
            if item.n_values > 0 and getattr(item.time_axis, "period_us", None) is not None
        ]
        return ImportedRecordSummary(
            record_id=record.record_id,
            record_key=imported_record_key(record.record_id),
            series_count=len(series),
            value_count=sum(item.n_values for item in series),
            duration_seconds=max(durations) if durations else None,
            signals=sorted({str(item.signal) for item in series})[:20],
            annotation_keys=sorted({str(item.key) for item in record.annotations})[:20],
            is_replay_compatible=replay_compatible,
        )


def imported_record_key(record_id: str) -> str:
    return hashlib.sha256(record_id.encode()).hexdigest()[:24]

def stream(self, job):
        try:
            last_id = int(self.headers.get("Last-Event-ID", "0"))
            if last_id < 0:
                raise ValueError()
        except ValueError:
            raise ApiError(400, "INVALID_EVENT_ID", "Last-Event-ID must be a nonnegative integer.") from None
        self.send_response(200)
        self.send_header("Content-Type", "text/event-stream")
        self.send_header("Cache-Control", "no-cache, no-transform")
        self.send_header("X-Accel-Buffering", "no")
        self.send_header("Connection", "close")
        self.end_headers()
        self.close_connection = True
        while True:
            with job.condition:
                pending = [event for event in job.events if int(event["id"]) > last_id]
                if not pending and job.finished_at is None:
                    job.condition.wait(timeout=10)
                    pending = [event for event in job.events if int(event["id"]) > last_id]
                done = job.finished_at is not None
            for event in pending:
                self.wfile.write(f"id: {event['id']}\nevent: {event['type']}\ndata: {json.dumps(event, allow_nan=False)}\n\n".encode())
                last_id = int(event["id"])
            if not pending and not done:
                self.wfile.write(b": keepalive\n\n")
            self.wfile.flush()
            if done:
                return

{"body":"## Summary

- persist revision-pinned GitHub, Zenodo, and Hugging Face approvals in a durable, paginated source library
- accept only approved source and asset IDs, with one persisted ingestion job per approved source revision
- securely acquire provider files, reuse verified SHA-256 content, and safely extract bounded archives without executing downloaded code
- expose durable per-asset receipts and display verified bytes, asset counts, and percentage while acquisition is running
- inventory CSV, TSV, Parquet, NPY, NPZ, MAT, and HDF5 resources and pause ambiguous mappings for explicit channel-unit confirmation
- build and read back validated TimeF datasets for wide, long, and named-array layouts, retaining immutable public receipts
- preserve exact KUKA Part I and Part II dispatch, licensing, 1 kHz torque/position series, and distinct publisher annotations
- accept the published KUKA datasets as complete sets of separate batch archives while retaining stable batch/run provenance
- browse a validated import through bounded, paginated TimeF record summaries tied to the exact receipt version
- display approved sources, approval history, assets, job state, mapping decisions, ready receipts, and imported records in the compact Data sources workspace
- return an existing ready result instead of ingesting a persisted source repeatedly
- let users cancel asset selection and delete an unreferenced approved source after explicit confirmation while retaining its sourcing-run audit
- keep deleted catalog entries removed across restarts, restoring them only after a genuinely new approval event
- start the complete local stack from one script: scout, ingestion API, worker, fixture inference bridge, and frontend

## Validation

- data sourcing: Ruff clean; 99 tests passed
- data ingestion: 163 tests and 5 subtests passed after syncing origin/main at 88c537a
- frontend: 106 tests passed; production build passed
- inference: 25 focused server/runtime tests passed
- reported Zenodo import completed: 42 archives, 8,975,699,829 verified bytes, 206 records, 2,884 series, and 499,662,142 values passed deterministic TimeF read-back
- the new record endpoint was exercised against that completed import and returned exact-version summaries from all 206 records
- browser: imported-dataset navigation, focus, loading/error feedback, Cancel paths, and console cleanliness verified; successful record rendering is covered by the live endpoint response plus frontend contract/component tests
- split-archive regression verifies unique `batch-XX/run` provenance and closed failure for incomplete batch sets
- dependency audit: 0 frontend vulnerabilities
- Entire hooks active; branch merged with origin/main at 88c537a; diff check clean

## Acceptance boundaries

- provider acquisition unit cases use deterministic mocked HTTP inputs; the reported KUKA import is the completed local full-source case
- imported record browsing returns metadata only: record identity, duration, counts, signal names, and annotation keys; it does not return raw arrays or silently add the import to the inference fixture catalog
- existing audited challenge evidence covers one original full recording per part; completing this import does not revise benchmark or model claims
- acquisition progress is durable verified progress and advances after each asset is fully verified; it does not estimate in-flight bytes within the current archive
- unfamiliar formats and ambiguous semantics remain visible as unsupported or awaiting user input; generic ingestion does not guess units or execute source code
- approved sources with an existing ingestion job cannot be deleted from the UI, preserving ingestion provenance
- deleting a source removes it from the approved catalog but retains the originating sourcing-run artifacts for audit
- the existing RobotPanel bundle-size warning remains unchanged

const r = await tools.exec_command({cmd:"gh pr edit 19 --repo ukafkasyali/ysamet --body '## Summary

- persist revision-pinned GitHub, Zenodo, and Hugging Face approvals in a durable, paginated source library
- securely acquire selected assets once, expose verified byte progress, inventory common dataset formats, and build deterministic TimeF outputs
- preserve exact KUKA dispatch while accepting the published split batch archives and retaining stable batch/run provenance
- display approved sources, approval history, asset selection, mapping decisions, immutable receipts, and imported record pages in Data sources
- let users cancel asset selection and delete an unreferenced approved source after confirmation
- start the scout, ingestion API, worker, fixture inference bridge, and frontend from one local script
- mark imported records replay-compatible only when they contain seven synchronized canonical torque channels at 1 kHz
- open a compatible TimeF record as the active frontend replay, including bounded overview data, publisher annotations, initial raw detail, and later raw-window retrieval
- update Recording and Current recording when an imported record opens; default imported records to All 7 signals
- keep imported replay limited to deterministic measurements until the inference bridge has an explicit trusted archive adapter

## Validation

- data sourcing: Ruff clean; 99 tests passed
- data ingestion: 165 tests and 5 subtests passed
- frontend: 108 tests passed; production build passed
- inference: 26 server/runtime tests passed after merging origin/main and preserving the new CNN runtime plus no-load fixture startup
- reported Zenodo import completed: 42 archives, 8,975,699,829 verified bytes, 206 records, 2,884 series, and 499,662,142 values passed deterministic TimeF read-back
- browser-verified the persisted import end to end: first record opened as a 232-second replay with seven signals and 27 publisher annotations, Current recording changed, the raw interval showed 5.641–10.641 seconds, and playback advanced
- exact 7 by 1,024 raw-window retrieval was exercised against the completed import
- dependency audit: 0 frontend vulnerabilities
- Entire hooks active; branch merged with origin/main at e817441; diff check clean

## Acceptance boundaries

- provider unit cases use deterministic mocked HTTP inputs; the reported KUKA import is the completed local full-source case
- record summaries are bounded and paginated; replay responses cap overview points and expose raw windows on demand
- only compatible seven-joint 1 kHz torque records can enter replay; other imported layouts remain metadata-only and are never coerced
- imported records do not currently provide OpenTSLM inference or recorded joint-position animation; the UI says measurements only and does not imply exact pose reconstruction
- publisher markers remain source annotations, not verified physical onset or diagnosis
- existing audited challenge evidence and deployed model are unchanged by this ingestion work
- acquisition progress advances after each asset is fully verified; it does not estimate in-flight bytes within an archive
- unfamiliar formats and ambiguous semantics remain unsupported or awaiting user input; ingestion does not guess units or execute source code
- approved sources with an existing ingestion job cannot be deleted, preserving ingestion provenance
- the existing RobotPanel bundle-size warning remains unchanged
